about: Shared cases for the clean-verbatim quote rule. Run by verbatim_test.ts (TypeScript), tests/test_verbatim.py in curated-sermons/pipelines/embeddings (Python), and against public.is_clean_verbatim() in SQL. 'check': the word rule alone (cleanSpan / clean_span / is_clean_verbatim). 'destutter': fillers and stutters left out of a finished quote. 'problem': quoteProblem / quote_problem on a finished quote. 'build': the model's pick rebuilt from the transcript (buildQuote / build_quote); seg_words/seg_times default to one caption line.
